seo.title: Features — Momentum Habit Tracker
seo.description: Explore Momentum's features: weekly view, daily scheduling, streak tracking, habit stacking, environment design, and more.
seo.keywords: habit tracker features, weekly habit view, daily schedule, streak tracking, habit stacking tool

hero.headline: Everything you need to build lasting habits.
hero.subline: Momentum isn't just a checklist — it's a complete habit system with scheduling, cues, stacking, rewards, and visual tracking.

items.title: Weekly View
items.description: See your entire week at a glance. Every moment, every slot, colour-coded by completion status so you can spot patterns instantly.

items.title: Daily Schedule
items.description: Your day laid out in 30-minute slots from wake to sleep. Know exactly what comes next — no decision fatigue.

items.title: Dashboard & Streaks
items.description: Track your completion rates, streaks, and consistency across all your moments over time. Stay motivated with real data.

items.title: Moment Builder
items.description: Define habits with cues, stacks, environment prompts and rewards — the full behaviour-science system, not just a name and a checkbox.

items.title: Habit Stacking
items.description: Chain habits together — 'after I do X, I do Y'. The proven technique from Atomic Habits, built right into the scheduling.

items.title: Flexible Config
items.description: Set your wake time, sleep time, slot duration, and preferences. Momentum adapts to your life, not the other way around.

sections.heading: Built on behaviour science
sections.body: Every feature in Momentum is grounded in research. Cue-routine-reward loops, identity-based habits, environment design — these aren't buzzwords, they're the architecture of the app. We built it this way because checklists don't change behaviour — systems do.

sections.heading: Fast, private, and yours
sections.body: Momentum is a server-rendered SPA — it loads fast, works on any device, and your data stays on our servers (not sold to third parties). No ads, no tracking pixels, no dark patterns.
